pages.text: It is a higher level panakeia sublimated by capturing the light of the nether. It can be used as a material for more advanced alchemy kits, for the first ink for engraving runes, and for strengthening metals such as gold. By right clicking on the head of a wither skeleton, it becomes a T4 panakeia.

pages.title: T3 Panakeia Material
pages.text: T3 Panakeia can strengthens these metals into T3 Panakeia ingots.
